fullDescription: A sophisticated, corporate-modern data-viz aesthetic optimized for BI Analysts, FinTech, and enterprise SaaS. Featuring a deep navy #0D1B2A background, electric blue #1E90FF accents, and amber #F4A261 highlights, the style pairs Space Grotesk's geometric boldness with JetBrains Mono's precision. Key features include animated grid backgrounds, floating data nodes, scroll-triggered number counters, and interactive vertical timelines, creating a 'McKinsey meets Tableau' professional feel.
prompt:
## Resumo
Professional dark-mode portfolio and dashboard style with a focus on data visualization elements, precise typography, and technical sophistication.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design system based on a 'Data Modernist' aesthetic. Backgrounds: Deep Navy (#0D1B2A) for main sections, Navy 800 (#1B2838) for cards. Accents: Electric Blue (#1E90FF) and Amber (#F4A261). Typography: Space Grotesk for headings (Weight 700 for titles, 500 for subheaders); JetBrains Mono for metrics and labels (Weight 400). Layout: 60x60px background grid using rgba(30,144,255,0.05) lines. Components: Cards should have a 1px border (#243447) and 12px-16px border-radius. Shadows: Use subtle electric blue glows (rgba(30,144,255,0.12)) for hover states. Animation: Cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for all transitions. Scroll behavior: Smooth.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Navigation
Fixed header height: 64px. Background: #0D1B2A with 1px bottom border (#243447). Left: Logo text with electric blue first character. Right: Links with font-size: 14px, color: #8892A4. Hover state: #F5F7FA with a 2px electric blue bottom underline (#1E90FF) that expands from the center.

### Hero Section
Full-height (min-h-screen) with a background grid. Center-left: Status badge with pulse animation (Green #4ADE80). H1 Heading: Space Grotesk, size 72px, leading-none. CTAs: Primary button in Electric Blue (#1E90FF), secondary button with thin border (#2E4057). Right-side: A 'Key Performance Snapshot' card featuring 3 progress bars with animated counters (#1E90FF, #F4A261, #4ADE80).

### Impact Metrics Bar
Full-width section with background #1B2838. Five columns of metrics. Typography: 48px font-size for numbers in JetBrains Mono. Subtext: 14px uppercase muted labels. Animation: Numbers must count up from zero on scroll visibility.

### Experience Timeline
Vertical center-aligned path using a 1px gradient line (#1E90FF to transparent). Experience nodes: Left-side spacing (64px) for content. Cards: Interactive, expanding on click to reveal bulleted lists. Indicators: 16px circles with pulse-ring effects.

### Bento-Style Skill Grid
Grid layout (4 columns on desktop). Cards: #1B2838 background. Each card features an icon box (10% opacity background of the icon color) and 'skill chips'. Interaction: Skill chips gain a bottom 2px electric blue border and lift 2px on hover.

### Project Cards
3-column grid. Top: Gradient placeholder (20% opacity) with a large icon centered. Bottom: Title, description, and technical tags (JetBrains Mono). Interaction: 0.4s transform-scale (1.02) and deep blue box-shadow on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Data Node Background — Subtle floating dots connected by faint lines.
Implement a background layer of 6px dots (#1E90FF) at varying opacities (0.2 to 0.6). Animate them with a floating vertical motion (translateY: -20px) using alternating 4s and 5s durations. Each node should have a 80px horizontal gradient tail.

### Skill Chip — Minimalist tag with hover-triggered underline.
Background: #0D1B2A; Border: 1px #243447; Font: 12px JetBrains Mono. On hover: Change background to rgba(30,144,255,0.12), border to #1E90FF, and slide a 2px blue line from left-to-right along the bottom edge.

### Metric Progress Bar — Dash-inspired progress visualization.
Track: #2E4057, 6px height, full width. Fill: Dynamic color (Electric Blue/Amber), rounded ends. Label: Right-aligned animated counter text in bold JetBrains Mono.

## Notas Especiais
Must maintain 1px thin lines to preserve the technical 'engineering' feel. Do not use overly rounded corners (limit to 16px). Monospace fonts are mandatory for all numeric data and technical tags. Use grid backgrounds sparingly to avoid visual noise; limit opacity to 5-10%.

style.description: The style is characterized by high-contrast dark-mode surfaces using a primary navy palette (#0D1B2A), accented by vibrant electric blue (#1E90FF) for primary actions and amber (#F4A261) for secondary highlights. Typography focuses on geometric sans-serifs for headings to imply authority and monospace fonts for metrics to imply technical accuracy. Visual interest is generated through thin grid lines, subtle parallax effects, and micro-animations that mimic data processing.
